measurement_limitations: Each completed context point is one run; descriptive only.
Prefill is client-observed prompt token count divided by time-to-first-token, not internal engine telemetry.
The 142813-token Sherlock corpus is repeated above its length; this is a synthetic throughput fixture, not long-context retrieval quality.
The 8K point at window 1048576 is separate from the earlier 8K pilot at window 131072 (three-run median).
